_meta.use: Expected Expo push messages (CONTRACTS §5) for the notify tests and the app routing tests. Names come from personas.json. data.url must be routable by Expo Router.

messages.title: Sam answered today's question
messages.body: Your turn. Answer to unlock theirs.

messages.title: You both answered
messages.body: Maya's answer is ready. Hold to reveal.

messages.title: Bonded
messages.body: It's your ritual time. Today's question is waiting.

messages.title: Your 11-day streak is waiting
messages.body: Answer together before midnight to keep it going.

messages.title: Sam is waiting
messages.body: Sam is waiting to see your answer.

messages.title: Sam joined you on Bonded
messages.body: You're paired. See today's question together.

messages.title: You're both Premium
messages.body: Maya's plan covers you too. Every pack is open.

suppression_cases.expect: not sent; notify answers {sent:0, suppressed:1} and writes no push_log row (claimed or sent rows of every type count, suppressed rows do not; recipient-local day)
not sent and not queued, no push_log row (quiet hours 23:00 inclusive to 07:00 exclusive, recipient profile timezone; also for partner_joined and nudge)

the first reply pushes at once; replies and reactions on the same question within the next 5 minutes (inclusive) are not pushed; the first one after that pushes again (BE-08). The notifications.json `grouped` copy ("{count} new replies and reactions") is not sent by notify: open question to the lead (QA-05)
not sent (both_answered too; nudge and thread_activity still go)
